sources.title: NTT DATA: 京阪奈OSK11データセンター facility page (version modified 20 October 2026; captured 27 October 2026)
sources.summary: NTT DATA's Keihanna OSK11 page says that the 京阪奈OSK11データセンター, which opened in February 2026 (2026年2月にオープンした), is a four-storey base-isolated building that supplies a total IT load of 30 MW to 10,900 m2 of server rooms, and describes in the present tense that it provides sustainable and secure service, combines pre-registered entry, an unattended reception, multi-factor authentication, rack-level access control and 24-hour on-site guards, and offers renewable-energy supply on request. It states that the facility is built next to an NTT group R&D facility, lies in 京都府相楽郡精華町, and lists 所在地 京都府精華町, total floor area about 28,894 m2, four floors, opening February 2026, up to 3,800 racks, receiving capacity up to 77 kV, base-isolated structure, 2,000 kg/m2 floor loading, up to 7.89 kW per rack, 48 hours of generator fuel, carrier-neutral with three building entries, and Tier III equivalence. February 2026 is the operator-stated opening month, not the observation date.
